title: B.Sc. in Natural Sciences
description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 51 units of courses as follows: Students must choose one concentration area and take at least 32 units of courses (including at least 3 units of research course(s)) among the subject areas prescribed under required courses and corresponding concentration area courses, namely Biological Sciences, Biotechnology, Environmental Studies, Food and Nutrition, Data Science, Chemical and Testing Sciences, and Physical Sciences. Students will fulfill this unit requirement automatically by taking the relevant courses as prescribed in each concentration area. Upon completion of all courses prescribed under a concentration area, the concentration area will be printed on academic transcript.

subsections.title: At least 8 units of courses shall be taken from the following courses
Elective Courses[a]
text: No more than 3 units of courses at 1000 level and at least 32 units of courses at 3000 and above level shall be taken from Elective Courses, and at least 24 units of courses shall be taken from Concentration Area Courses, of which at least 6 units are courses at 4000 level (including at least 3 units of research courses taken from BIOL4901, 4902, 4903, CMBI4901, 4902, 4903, LSCI4000, MBTE4901, 4902, 4903, NSCI4906):

subsections.title: Elective Courses[a]
text: No more than 3 units of courses at 1000 level and at least 32 units of courses at 3000 and above level shall be taken from Elective Courses, and at least 17 units of courses shall be taken from Concentration Area Courses, of which at least 6 units are courses at 4000 level (including at least 3 units of research courses taken from LSCI4000, MBTE4901, 4902, 4903):

subsections.title: Elective Courses[a]
text: No more than 3 units of courses at 1000 level and at least 29 units of courses at 3000 and above level shall be taken from Elective Courses, and at least 17 units of courses shall be taken from Concentration Area Courses, of which at least 4 units of laboratory courses taken from BIOL4012, EESC2517, 3417, 3530, and at least 6 units are courses at 4000 level (including at least 3 units of research courses taken from BIOL4901, 4902, 4903, EESC4810, 4820, LSCI4000, NSCI4906):

subsections.title: Elective Courses[a]
text: No more than 3 units of courses at 1000 level and at least 32 units of courses at 3000 and above level shall be taken from Elective Courses, and at least 19 units of courses shall be taken from Concentration Area Courses, of which at least 6 units are FNSC courses at 4000 level (including at least 3 units of research courses taken from BIOL4901, 4902, 4903, LSCI4000, MBTE4901, 4902, 4903, NSCI4906):

subsections.title: Elective Courses[a]
text: At least 26 units of courses at 3000 and above level shall be taken from Elective Courses. At least 17 units of courses shall be taken from the Concentration Area Courses, of which at least 3 units are courses at 4000 level:

subsections.title: Elective Courses[a]
text: At least 20 units of courses at 3000 and above level shall be taken from Elective Courses. At least 4 units of courses shall be taken from the Concentration Area Courses:

subsections.title: 9 units of courses shall be taken from the following courses
One each from either two groups listed as follows
Elective Courses[a]
text: At least 10 units of courses at 2000 level and at least 26 units of courses at 3000 and above level shall be taken from Elective Courses, and at least 23 units of courses shall be taken from Concentration Area Courses, of which at least 6 units are courses at 4000 level (including at least 3 units of research courses taken from CHEM4960, 4970, EESC4810, 4820, PHYS4610, 4620, 4710, 4811):

notes.text: BCHE/BIOL/CHEM/CMBI/EESC/FNSC/LSCI/MATH/MBTE/NSCI/PHYS/RMSC/STAT courses at 2000 and above level will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.
These courses if not taken to fulfill the requirement as prescribed in Required Courses can be taken to fulfill the requirement as prescribed in Elective Courses.

Students should take the required number of units of Elective Courses (Item 2) in accordance with the units completed in Required Courses (Item 1) to fulfill the 51 units of courses of Major Programme Requirement.
Students taking PHYS1002 instead of PHYS1111 may not be able to take some of the PHYS courses because PHYS1111 is a prerequisite for some Physics courses.
Students may, with written approval by the Natural Sciences Programme, use one or more of the following courses to substitute those listed: MATH2055, 2070, 2230, 3010, 3230, 3240, 4220
